vectors.title: Canonical topical state synchronization
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Start a pinned reference node with fixture topic tm_tpnil_reference and a canonical admitted UTXO graph.
Start an empty SUT and invoke its declared synchronization mechanism.
Observe bounded convergence through the declared HTTP boundaries.
expected: Canonical topical outpoints, amounts, scripts, spending relationships and retained ancestors match the independently derived set.
Unknown topics remain separate and no extra admitted outputs appear.
blockers: Frozen synchronization transport and convergence bound

vectors.title: Submission and duplicate semantics
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Submit the pinned BEEF transaction to the fixture topic over HTTP.
Repeat the same submission according to the profile.
expected: Per-topic admission response matches the independently computed acceptance set.
Repeated delivery does not duplicate canonical topical outputs or effects.

vectors.title: Lookup service interoperability
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Query the declared ls_tpnil_reference lookup service using the canonical query.
Resolve every referenced output against its returned transaction data.
expected: Result type, output selection, BEEF associations and declared ordering satisfy the frozen lookup contract.
Topic names and lookup service names are not interchanged.
blockers: Canonical query schema and fixture oracle

vectors.title: Incremental, resumed and bidirectional synchronization
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Add and spend fixture outputs on the source.
Interrupt a planned sync between declared checkpoints, restart, and repeat.
Run the reverse direction with a fresh isolated state.
expected: Final state equals the canonical latest set without omissions or duplicates.
Replayed checkpoints preserve the declared causality and ancestor retention rules.

vectors.title: Specified rejection and chain changes
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Apply the corpus of rejected local transactions and topic-inadmissible outputs.
Apply a predeclared regtest reorganization when this profile is selected.
expected: No rejected fixture output appears as admitted state.
Reorganization behavior matches the selected anchor/rollback profile and is distinguishable from ordinary convergence.

vectors.title: Complete public boundary inventory
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Enumerate the pinned submission, lookup, discovery and synchronization methods selected by this profile.
Execute each applicable request/result/error and transport assertion.
expected: Coverage map has no unexplained mandatory boundary omissions.
Administrative routes are separately scoped and confer no public-boundary coverage.
